description:
Current liquor licences per suburb by type (pubs, restaurants, bottle shops, clubs, producers), late-night licences and a per-address density, for Victoria and New South Wales.

Coverage: Victoria (as at 31 Aug 2026) and New South Wales (as at 7 Jun 2024). Other states return no data. Current to 2026-08-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/liquor-licences`.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: licences_total, pubs_hotels, restaurants_on_premises, bottle_shops, clubs, producers_wholesalers, limited_temporary, other, late_night_3am, licences_per_1000_addresses. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_area_stats_liquor_licences
title: Suburb · Liquor licences
